title: Dining Account Billing Terms Schedule - Dining Plan
content:
Statement, late fee, returned payment and dispute figures of the Dining Plan dining account, by plan:

| Plan | Day of the month the dining statement falls due | Calendar days after the due date before a late fee may be assessed | Late fee on a past-due statement (USD) | Past-due amount below which no late fee is assessed (USD) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Calendar days after posting within which a charge or redemption may be disputed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dining 10 Meal Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Dining 15 Meal Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Dining 30 Meal Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Dining 45 Meal Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Dining 60 Meal Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Dining Full Board Plan | 1 | 10 | 20.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |

## Notes to the schedule

- Every figure is the same on all six plans.
- The late fee is a flat 20.00 US dollars; it is not a percentage of the amount past due.
- The 50.00 US dollar figure is a floor: a past-due amount below it attracts no late fee.
- The grace period of 10 days and the dispute window of 60 days are both counted in calendar days.
